cards.title: WEAVE: objective-led education and feedback
cards.practice: Wonder defines audience needs; Explore sets learning goals; Action implements; Verify examines learning; Echo uses feedback for the next revision.
cards.reflection: The team framework connects activity choices to audience needs and subsequent improvement.
cards.adaptation: Use the phases to explain why each activity is included and how understanding will be checked.

cards.title: Plant-to-product route-card workshop
cards.location: Joint design proposal: green manufacturing route puzzle
cards.practice: The proposal asks learners to arrange raw-material, conversion and product cards, compare two project routes and justify a new waste-use choice.
cards.reflection: The proposal recommends an accessible process-level story and lists learner explanations and decision reasons as intended evaluation records.
cards.adaptation: Use a printed route puzzle with short group explanations in a classroom without laboratory equipment. Treat the new agenda as a proposed adaptation.

cards.title: Adapt the detection activity to available equipment
cards.practice: The team draft describes replacing a fluorescence-identification activity after a pre-test did not yield a clear distinction; digital pH meters offered an alternative.
cards.reflection: The narrative links the redesign to an observed implementation limitation and the partner laboratory resources.
cards.adaptation: Pre-test the educational task. For a classroom-only plan, use prepared evidence cards instead of assuming access to an instrument.

cards.title: DNA builder: pair and inspect bases
cards.practice: The implemented resource lets users assemble nucleotides and inspect base pairing and a two- or three-dimensional helix.
cards.reflection: The repository describes functionality; it does not report an evaluated learning gain.
cards.adaptation: Use a projected worked example followed by paper base-pair cards and a short explanation task.

cards.title: Fermentation map: connect microbes and familiar foods
cards.practice: The resource connects familiar fermented foods with microbial conditions through a regional map and virtual lab.
cards.reflection: The catalog records the resource purpose and interface, rather than an educational-impact measurement.
cards.adaptation: Ask learners to compare two familiar examples and state which conditions a microbial process needs.

cards.title: Heidelberg: explanation, practice and quiz
cards.practice: Heidelberg combined illustrated protocols, calculators and quizzes; learner feedback informed the addition of laboratory videos.
cards.reflection: The report links complementary formats to feedback from students and educators.
cards.adaptation: Follow one short illustrated explanation with a worked example and a check-for-understanding question.

cards.title: BUCT: drawing-to-clay learning with individual support
cards.location: Equ-Globalizing: children with special educational needs
cards.practice: BUCT used illustrated explanations, drawings and colored-clay models, with individual facilitator support.
cards.reflection: Teacher reflections and participant creations were used as feedback about participation and understanding.
cards.adaptation: Offer drawing and tactile options; collect a learner explanation and a facilitator observation rather than relying on speed or a written quiz.
